blocks.x: Underwriting evidence assembled in hours — case cycle time down 44%

A leading life insurer (North America) — a Insurance & Risk engagement delivered by a blended Achala IT Solutions team under the outcome-linked engagement model. Identity withheld as standard; the figures are the client's, reproduced with permission.
APS records and paramedical data arrived as faxes and PDFs; evidence assembly took 9 days average per case.
Underwriting health data spread across systems with inconsistent access control. Lapse signals arrived too late for retention action.

KYC Management System agents classify, extract and assemble underwriting evidence with confidence routing; the actuarial data workbench on Forge unified valuation and experience pipelines with lineage for LDTI reporting; sensitive health data moved under classification-aware controls. Lapse models now trigger retention actions within weeks of drift signals.

blocks.x: The three things that made it hold

items: the agents ran inside a policy envelope with replay, so autonomy never outran the evidence.
the data spine was certified once and reused everywhere, which is why the numbers held up under audit.
blast radius and lateral movement were priced in the design, which is what the auditor actually tested.

blocks.x: What transferred directly from the leading life insurer (North America) program: the decision pattern and the evidence design. What never transfers: the estate's quirks — which is why every program re-runs the baseline diagnostic on its own data before any build The engagement model here was build-transfer; the same pattern runs fixed-scope where the estate allows it.
Figures on this page are the client's, reproduced with permission. Method notes and measurement designs are available under NDA.
Start with the diagnostic, not the contract: the same diagnostic baselined in two weeks, and a scoped proposal only if the delta justifies it.
